expected_findings.root_cause: _run_wait decides whether to call the wait strategy by truthiness of self.wait instead of checking for the explicit no-wait values None and 0
expected_findings.failure_path: a wait strategy object that is falsy, for example a user-defined strategy subclassing list or tuple to hold its parameters, or a strategy class that defines __len__ or __bool__, is never called: `if not self.wait` takes the no-wait branch, every retry sleeps 0 seconds and the configured backoff disappears without any error; under a flaky dependency the client hammers it at full speed
